item.title: Forum Criticism Team - Captain Post
item.content:encoded:
maybe consider coming up with a elaborate and some what dark back story.

This can run the risk of the character seeming like a self-indulgent edgy cool OC, rather than a coherent individual whose story is created to be interesting to a wider audience. How would an elaborate backstory improve the current setup? Why would it need to be "somewhat dark"?

item.title: Admin Post - Info - Open
item.content:encoded: jacked-anime-cole, instead of posting multiple comments in succession, please edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of every comment. That prevents spam buildup, and it's in the rules.

item.title: JS Staff Post -- Forum Crit -- Info
item.content:encoded:
Author,

Per the required reading forum guidelines, please fill out the concept template to seek feedback on your idea:

 **Seeking Greenlights:** Put yes or no. **Page Type:** SCP Article, Tale, GoI Format, Joke SCP, Site Dossier, Other (specify) **Genre (Optional):** Horror, Drama/Emotional, Comedy, Action, History, Other (specify) **Page Layout (Optional):** [How will you will structure the page in terms of information presentation, or plot development? If you plan on using a unique format/format screw, describe that here.] **Elevator Pitch:** [What is the basic core idea? Use a bullet point list if necessary.] **Central Narrative:** [Describe the story beats or overarching context/"big picture" for your piece. If there is no story content, put "none".] **Hook/Attention-Grabber:** [What is novel/unique about your premise? What is special about your idea here that will make it stand out among the other works already on the mainsite?] **Additional Notes:** [Note any concerns or particular areas of assistance you would like reviewers to focus on.]

Rather than posting a new comment, edit your previous post using the "edit" function under the "options" tab to the lower right of your first comment.

Remember that the combined text for your answers to the last four sections (Elevator Pitch, Central Narrative, Hook/Attention-Grabber, and Additional Notes) MAY NOT exceed 400 words. For convenience, authors can use this page to check wordcount: https://wordcounter.net/

Once you have revised your post accordingly, please reach out to reviewers to request that they look at your thread. You can find example lists of contacts in the Required Reading thread linked above.

item.title: Re: Small SCP idea
item.content:encoded: interesting concept. however, you should consider abiding by the forum template so we can get a more in depth explanation of this scp. since you said it was similar to 999, have it stand out from that scp. it is not good for people to think you are "copying" an scp. maybe consider coming up with a elaborate and some what dark back story.

item.title: Re: Small SCP idea
item.content:encoded: Originally, it was planned to have an obsession over a fictional character, however, this was removed because it wasn't written well. Any ideas to replace that crucial event and detail?

item.title: Small SCP idea
item.content:encoded: I had the idea of an SCP who draws a lot and acts somewhat like 999 in a way. It draws stuff for the D-Class personnel and any others it enjoys being around. However, to balance it out I was thinking of some sort of memetic effect or a deadly reason not to come into contact with it's skin. I use to have one written out for it, and a bunch of reasons why it would go out of it's way to harm someone, but it doesn't sound or look the best. Does this sound half decent?
